title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,351–3,400 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: High schools invest in quality rubber running tracks to promote track athletics.
examples.zh: 高中校園積極鋪設優質國際標準 PU 田徑跑道，全力推廣青少年田徑體育運動。

examples.en: She showed a natural talent for athletics from a very young age.
examples.zh: 她從很小的時候就展現出了在田徑與體育運動方面的過人天賦。

examples.en: The university athletic department allocates scholarships to support collegiate athletics.
examples.zh: 該大學體育室特別提撥專款獎學金，大力支持大專校院各項體育競賽。

examples.en: Dedicated national athletes train six hours daily to qualify for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 刻苦耐勞的國家培訓隊國手運動員每日苦練六小時，力拼取得前進奧運資格。

examples.en: Professional athletes must follow strict nutritional guidelines during competition season.
examples.zh: 職業運動員在激烈賽季期間必須恪守極為嚴格的運動營養飲食規範。

examples.en: He was named the high school's outstanding student athlete of the year.
examples.zh: 他榮獲該中學年度最佳品學兼優傑出學生運動員殊榮。

examples.en: The baseball team celebrated their thrilling championship victory with fans.
examples.zh: 職棒隊伍在滿場球迷彩帶飛揚的歡呼聲中，瘋狂慶祝勇奪年度總冠軍錦標。

examples.en: Tens of thousands of spectators packed into the stadium for the world championship match.
examples.zh: 數萬名狂熱球迷擠滿了現代化體育場，爭睹世界錦標賽總決賽。

examples.en: Winning the league championship had been the coach's ultimate goal for a decade.
examples.zh: 奪得聯盟年度總冠軍榮銜一直是這位總教練十年來夢寐以求的終極心願。

examples.en: Millions of proud citizens cheered for Taiwanese athletes during the Paris Olympics.
examples.zh: 數百萬國人守在電視機前齊心為巴黎奧運賽場上奮戰的台灣健兒熱血吶喊。

examples.en: The city spent billions upgrading public transit in preparation for hosting the Olympics.
examples.zh: 該城市斥資數十億美元全面升級大眾交通路網，以迎接主辦奧運盛會。

examples.en: Competing at the Summer Olympics is the lifelong dream of track and field competitors.
examples.zh: 能站上夏季奧運會的競技舞台，是所有田徑運動員終其一生的崇高夢想。

examples.en: Standing atop the gold medal podium brought proud tears to the champion's eyes.
examples.zh: 當雄赳赳站上象徵最高榮譽的金牌第一名領獎台時，冠軍選手不禁熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: All three medalists stepped onto the podium as their national anthems echoed through the arena.
examples.zh: 三位奪牌好手一同登上頒獎台，國歌旋律在整座宏偉的體育館內莊嚴迴盪。

examples.en: The guest lecturer stepped up to the podium and greeted the enthusiastic auditorium crowd.
examples.zh: 特邀客座講師穩步走上講台，親切地向台下熱情滿座的聽眾致意問好。

examples.en: Athletes proudly displayed their shining Olympic gold, silver, and bronze medals.
examples.zh: 奪牌國手在慶功記者會上自豪展示其歷經千錘百鍊奪下的閃亮奧運獎牌。

examples.en: She hung her first marathon finisher medal proudly on her bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 她滿心歡喜地將自己人生第一面全馬完賽獎牌掛在臥室牆上留念。

examples.en: The courageous firefighter was awarded a medal of honor for saving a trapped family.
examples.zh: 這位英勇的消防隊員因冒險救出受困火場的一家人而獲頒最高榮譽勳章。

examples.en: The sprinter shattered the national 100-meter sprint record by 0.05 seconds.
examples.zh: 短跑名將以 0.05 秒之差強勢打破並刷新了高懸多年的全國百米短跑紀錄。

examples.en: The heavy baseball hit the glass window and shattered it into tiny fragments.
examples.zh: 飛來的厚重棒球猛烈砸中玻璃窗，將整片窗戶震得粉碎成細小碎片。

examples.en: Unexpected market crashes can easily shatter the optimistic plans of young entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 突如其來的市場崩盤往往會輕易擊碎年輕創業者樂觀美好的擴張計畫。

examples.en: The marathon runner achieved a new personal best (PB) of under three hours.
examples.zh: 這位馬拉松業餘好手在台北馬拉松成功跑出了三小時內的全新個人最佳紀錄（PB）。

examples.en: He celebrated hitting a personal best by bench pressing 120 kilograms at the gym today.
examples.zh: 他今天在健身房臥推達到 120 公斤，開心地慶祝自己達成了個人歷史新紀錄。

examples.en: Focused training in cold weather helped the swimmer clock a stunning personal best.
examples.zh: 在寒冷天氣下的專注苦練幫助這名泳將在計時賽中飆出了令人驚艷的個人最佳成績。

examples.en: Badminton is beloved across Taiwan, popularized by world-class champions.
examples.zh: 在戴資穎與李洋、王齊麟等世界頂級國手的帶動下，羽球已成為台灣全民運動。

examples.en: Friends often rent indoor courts on Friday evenings to play friendly games of badminton.
examples.zh: 三五好友經常在週五晚上租下室內球場，打幾場輕鬆愉快的羽球友誼賽。

examples.en: Advanced badminton requires tremendous wrist flexibility, quick footwork, and tactical smashes.
examples.zh: 高階羽球競技需要極強的手腕爆發力、靈活多變的步伐以及精準犀利的殺球。

examples.en: Fast-paced table tennis rallies demand lightning-fast hand-eye coordination.
examples.zh: 節奏極快的桌球抽球對攻極度考驗選手電光石火般的敏銳手眼協調反應。

examples.en: The community activity center installed three new tables for seniors to play table tennis.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心新添購了三張國際標準球桌，供社區長輩們打桌球切磋球技。

examples.en: Applying varied top-spin and back-spin gives table tennis serves deceptive trajectories.
examples.zh: 施加不同角度的上旋與下旋球，賦予了桌球發球極具欺騙性的刁鑽飛行弧線。

examples.en: Passionate fans chant rhythmic cheers at Chinese Professional Baseball League games.
examples.zh: 熱血沸騰的棒球迷在中華職棒（CPBL）例行賽看台上整齊劃一跳著嗆司應援曲。

examples.en: Little League baseball tournaments ignite national pride during summer championships.
examples.zh: 每年夏天盛大登場的世界少棒錦標賽總能瞬間點燃全台灣熱血沸騰的國球榮耀感。

examples.en: Dad gave his son a leather glove and taught him how to catch a baseball in the backyard.
examples.zh: 爸爸送給兒子一只真皮手套，並在後院親自教導他如何穩穩接住棒球。

examples.en: The cleanup hitter smashed a grand slam home run over the left-field fence.
examples.zh: 當家第四棒重砲手一棒揮出飛越左外野大牆、奠定勝局的滿貫全壘打。

examples.en: The marketing launch was an absolute home run, selling out product stock in minutes.
examples.zh: 這次新品上市行銷戰大獲全勝、一鳴驚人，短短幾分鐘內便將庫存搶購一空。

examples.en: Spectators scrambled to catch the flying home run ball landing in the right-field bleachers.
examples.zh: 看台上的球迷們紛紛爭相伸手搶接這顆落入右外野外野看台的全壘打紀念球。

examples.en: The ace starting pitcher threw a complete-game shutout with twelve strikeouts.
examples.zh: 王牌先發投手展現宰制全場的超強壓制力，狂飆十二次三振完封對手。

examples.en: The waiter placed a chilled glass pitcher of fresh lemonade on our patio table.
examples.zh: 服務生在我們戶外露台的餐桌上放了一壺冰涼沁甜的新鮮自製檸檬水。

examples.en: The relief pitcher warmed up quickly in the bullpen before entering the eighth inning.
examples.zh: 中繼後援投手在牛棚快速熱身練投，準備在關鍵第八局臨危受命登板拆彈。

examples.en: The stadium erupted in thunderous applause as the final batter struck out.
examples.zh: 當九局下半最後一名打者揮棒落空遭到三振出局時，整座球場瞬間陷入狂喜。

examples.en: He recorded a strikeout in his first plate appearance against the veteran curveball specialist.
examples.zh: 面對這名專投刁鑽曲球的資深老投手，他在生涯第一次站上打擊區時吞下了三振。

examples.en: High strikeout rates reflect a pitcher's dominance over opposing hitters.
examples.zh: 高奪三振率充分彰顯了一位頂尖強投面對敵隊打者時無與倫比的強大壓制統治力。

examples.en: The referee blew the whistle and awarded a penalty kick for a handball foul.
examples.zh: 主裁判吹響哨音，判定禁區內手球犯規並毫不猶豫判罰關鍵的十二碼罰球。

examples.en: Players must respect the match referee's final calls, even during contentious moments.
examples.zh: 即使在充滿爭議的關鍵判決時刻，場上球員也必須恪守規矩尊重主審裁判的裁決。

examples.en: After reviewing video replay footage, the referee overturned the earlier offside decision.
examples.zh: 在仔細檢視 VAR 慢動作重播畫面後，裁判改判推翻了先前越位犯規的原判。

words.definition: 運動家精神；公平競技風範

examples.en: Helping an injured opponent finish the race showed pure sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 在衝刺階段主動攙扶受傷倒地的對手一同跨越終點線，充分體現了崇高運動家精神。

examples.en: Shaking hands respectfully with your rivals after a painful loss demonstrates true sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 在歷經一場痛徹心扉的落敗後依然主動與對手握手致意，體現了真正的運動家風範。

examples.en: The league awards an annual trophy to the team displaying outstanding sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 職籃聯盟每年都會頒發一座榮譽獎盃，表彰在場上展現非凡體育道德與風範的模範球隊。

examples.en: Long-distance cycling builds cardiovascular fitness and muscular endurance.
examples.zh: 長距離公路自行車騎乘能大幅強化心肺功能並鍛鍊腿部核心的深層肌耐力。

examples.en: Mountaineering at extreme altitudes tests human mental and physical endurance to the absolute limit.
examples.zh: 在極高海拔的險峻雪山攀登，將人類的身心極限耐力推向了前所未有的考驗。

examples.en: Swimming continuous laps every morning is a fantastic way to develop total-body endurance.
examples.zh: 每天清晨堅持不懈地在泳池游上數十趟，是鍛鍊全身綜合耐力的極佳運動方式。

words.definition: 充沛體力；精力；持久體能

examples.en: Good nutrition and quality sleep are essential for rebuilding athletic stamina.
examples.zh: 充足均衡的優質營養攝取與深度睡眠是迅速恢復運動員體能充沛活力的核心。

examples.en: Midfield soccer players need extraordinary stamina to run twelve kilometers per match.
examples.zh: 足球隊的中場球員需要無比驚人的體力與充沛體能，才能在單場比賽中奔跑逾十二公里。

examples.en: Gradually increasing your weekly running mileage builds strong cardiovascular stamina.
examples.zh: 循序漸進地每週增加路跑累積里程數，能有效構築強大且持久的心肺耐力。

examples.en: Jogging and swimming are classic aerobic exercises that burn calories efficiently.
examples.zh: 慢跑與游泳皆屬於能高效率燃燒多餘脂肪熱量的經典全身性有氧運動。

examples.en: Doctors recommend thirty minutes of moderate aerobic activity at least five days a week.
examples.zh: 醫師建議每週至少維持五天、每次進行三十分鐘以上中等強度的規律有氧運動。

examples.en: Aerobic capacity measures how efficiently heart and lungs supply oxygen during workouts.
examples.zh: 最大有氧攝氧量是衡量心臟與肺部在運動過程中向全身肌肉輸送氧氣效率的核心指標。

examples.en: Sprinting and heavy deadlifts are powerful anaerobic strength builders.
examples.zh: 百米全力衝刺與大重量硬舉是能快速刺激肌肉生長的強力無氧爆發力訓練。

examples.en: Anaerobic metabolism produces lactic acid when muscles work without sufficient oxygen.
examples.zh: 當肌肉在極限高強度、缺乏充足氧氣供應下劇烈收縮時，無氧代謝會產生大量乳酸。

examples.en: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) blends short anaerobic bursts with brief recovery periods.
examples.zh: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）將短暫的極限無氧爆發衝刺與簡短的間歇緩和動態休息完美融合。

examples.en: Olympic gold-medal weightlifting requires explosive power and impeccable technique.
examples.zh: 奧運金牌級的舉重抓舉與挺舉競技需要極致的瞬間爆發力與無懈可擊的槓鈴技巧。

examples.en: Incorporating weightlifting into your weekly routine prevents age-related muscle loss.
examples.zh: 將重量訓練融入日常每週規律運動中，能有效防止隨著年齡增長而發生的肌少症肌肉流失。

examples.en: Proper footwear with a raised heel provides stability during heavy weightlifting movements.
examples.zh: 穿著具備硬底與微墊高鞋跟的專業舉重鞋，能為大重量舉重深蹲動作提供絕佳的腳底穩定度。

examples.en: Barbell back squats strengthen quadriceps, glutes, and lower body stability.
examples.zh: 槓鈴後深蹲動作能強效鍛鍊股四頭肌、臀大肌並大幅提升下半身核心穩定度。

examples.en: Make sure to keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes when you squat.
examples.zh: 在進行深蹲動作時，請務必保持胸膛挺拔直立，並讓膝蓋行進方向與腳尖自然平行對齊。

examples.en: He set a new gym record by performing a 180-kilogram barbell back squat.
examples.zh: 他以標準姿勢成功完成了 180 公斤的槓鈴後深蹲，刷新了該健身房的個人紀錄。

examples.en: Proper hip hinge form during deadlifts protects the lower spine from injury.
examples.zh: 在進行槓鈴硬舉時維持正確的髖關節鉸鏈發力姿勢能有效保護腰椎免於受傷。

examples.en: The powerlifter managed to deadlift more than two and a half times his body weight.
examples.zh: 這名力量舉重健力好手成功硬舉拉起了超過自身體重兩點五倍的大重量槓鈴。

examples.en: Incorporating the deadlift builds formidable posterior chain and grip strength.
examples.zh: 規律將硬舉訓練納入課表中能鍛造強悍無比的後側動力鏈與驚人的前臂握力。

examples.en: Dynamic stretching before workouts warms up cold joints and elastic muscles.
examples.zh: 運動前確實落實五到十分鐘的動態伸展，能預先喚醒緊繃關節並提升肌肉彈性。

examples.en: Ten minutes of gentle static stretching before bed relieves tension built up during the workday.
examples.zh: 睡前進行十分鐘輕柔的靜態伸展拉筋，能舒緩消除一整天久坐辦公累積的緊繃與疲勞。

examples.en: Gymnasts and dancers dedicate hours every day to intensive flexibility stretching.
examples.zh: 競技體操選手與芭蕾舞者每天皆投入數小時進行極具強度的身體柔韌度伸展訓練。

examples.en: Finish intense interval workouts with a light five-minute jog cool-down.
examples.zh: 在結束高強度間歇衝刺訓練後，請進行五分鐘輕度慢跑作為緩和收操放鬆。

examples.en: Skipping your post-run cool-down can lead to dizziness and excessive muscle tightness.
examples.zh: 跑步後若省略了緩和收操拉筋步驟，可能會導致心率驟降引發頭暈與肌肉過度僵硬。

examples.en: A comprehensive cool-down routine gradually brings your heart rate back to resting levels.
examples.zh: 一套完整扎實的運動後緩和收操，能讓狂跳的心率平穩漸進地回到正常靜態區間。

examples.en: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) usually peaks forty-eight hours post-workout.
examples.zh: 運動後引發的延遲性肌肉痠痛（DOMS）通常會在高強度重訓後的四十八小時達到頂峰。

examples.en: Taking a warm epsom salt bath helps alleviate chronic leg soreness after cycling.
examples.zh: 在長途騎乘單車後浸泡溫暖的瀉鹽熱水澡，有助於舒緩雙腿深層的肌肉痠痛疲憊。

examples.en: Gentle walking and foam rolling can stimulate blood flow to reduce acute soreness.
examples.zh: 輕度散步活動與使用滾筒筋膜放鬆能促進血液循環，從而有效減輕急性肌肉痠痛。

examples.en: Maintain proper hydration by sipping water every twenty minutes during hikes.
examples.zh: 在烈日下登山健行時，請養成每二十分鐘小口飲水補充水分的良好補水習慣。

examples.en: Severe dehydration impairs cognitive focus and causes rapid athletic fatigue.
examples.zh: 嚴重的體內脫水會大幅損害大腦思維專注力，並加速運動過程中的體力衰竭。

examples.en: Adequate daily hydration keeps skin elastic and supports healthy kidney function.
examples.zh: 每天攝取充足均衡的水分能維持肌膚水嫩彈性，並維持腎臟良好的代謝排毒機能。

examples.en: Replenish lost sodium and electrolytes with sports drinks after heavy sweating.
examples.zh: 大量出汗後適度飲用等滲透壓運動飲料，能即時補充流失的鈉與微量電解質。

examples.en: Cramping during endurance races is frequently caused by a sharp electrolyte imbalance.
examples.zh: 馬拉松與鐵人三項競賽中的突發小腿抽筋，往往是由於體內電解質急遽失衡所誘發。

examples.en: Coconut water is a natural beverage rich in potassium and vital electrolytes.
examples.zh: 新鮮天然椰子水是一種富含鉀離子與人體必需微量電解質的絕佳天然補給飲品。

examples.en: Drinking a whey protein shake within an hour aids rapid muscle repair.
examples.zh: 運動訓練後一小時內飲用一杯高純度乳清蛋白飲，有助於受損肌纖維迅速修復生長。

examples.en: Eggs, chicken breasts, and tofu are excellent dietary sources of complete protein.
examples.zh: 水煮蛋、去皮雞胸肉與優質嫩豆腐皆是日常飲食中極為出色的完全蛋白質來源。

examples.en: Athletes aiming for hypertrophy consume 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight.
examples.zh: 致力於肌肥大增肌的運動員通常每天攝取每公斤體重 1.6 到 2.2 克的充足蛋白質。

examples.en: Building lean muscle mass elevates your resting basal metabolism rate.
examples.zh: 積極增肌鍛鍊增加骨骼肌質量，能有效拉高人體在靜止狀態下的基礎新陳代謝率。

examples.en: Thyroid hormones play an indispensable role in regulating human metabolism and energy levels.
examples.zh: 甲狀腺荷爾蒙在調節人體日常新陳代謝速率與維持精力充沛方面扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Crash dieting often slows down your metabolism, making future weight rebound much more likely.
examples.zh: 極端節食往往會大幅拖慢自身的新陳代謝，導致日後體重更容易出現報復性反彈復胖。

examples.en: Combining resistance workouts with balanced diet lowers body fat percentage safely.
examples.zh: 重訓阻力運動搭配均衡原型食物飲食，能在不流失肌肉的前提下安全降低體脂率。

examples.en: The bioelectrical impedance scale measures bone density, skeletal muscle, and body fat.
examples.zh: 這款雙頻體脂計能精準分析骨質密度、骨骼肌質量與全身各部位的體脂肪率。

examples.en: Male marathon runners often maintain a lean body fat percentage between six and ten percent.
examples.zh: 男子菁英馬拉松頂尖選手的體脂肪率通常長年維持在百分之六到十的極致精實區間。

examples.en: A certified personal trainer customizes workout plans tailored to your goals.
examples.zh: 擁有專業國際證照的私人一對一健身教練能根據您的個人體態目標量身訂製課表。

examples.en: The dolphin trainer used positive reinforcement whistles during the aquatic show.
examples.zh: 海豚訓練師在海洋公園水上表演中運用口哨正向增強法引導海豚完成跳躍。

examples.en: She bought a sturdy new pair of running trainers before starting her half-marathon prep.
examples.zh: 在展開半馬備賽訓練前，她特地添購了一雙支撐性與緩震俱佳的專業慢跑運動鞋。

words.definition: 規律課表；例行公事；套路

examples.en: Consistency is key; stick strictly to your 4-day weekly workout routine.
examples.zh: 成功貴在堅持；請嚴格落實您每週安排的四天規律分部位重量健身課表。

examples.en: Establishing a soothing bedtime routine improves sleep quality and morning alertness.
examples.zh: 建立舒緩固定的睡前放鬆儀式能顯著提升睡眠品質，並讓隔日清晨神清氣爽。

examples.en: The figure skater practiced her choreographed technical jump routine dozens of times.
examples.zh: 花式滑冰選手在冰面上反覆苦練她那套融合高難度旋轉與編舞的競技比賽套路。

words.definition: 馬拉松長跑；持久戰 (42.195 km)

examples.en: Over twenty thousand runners conquered the scenic Taipei Marathon in winter.
examples.zh: 超過兩萬名熱血跑者在冬日清晨一同勇闖賽道平坦開闊的台北國際馬拉松。

examples.en: Preparing to run a marathon requires at least sixteen weeks of structured progressive mileage.
examples.zh: 想要順利完賽一場全程馬拉松，至少需要投入長達十六週循序漸進的系統化週跑量堆疊。

examples.en: Writing a comprehensive doctoral dissertation is an intellectual marathon of mental grit.
examples.zh: 撰寫一篇嚴謹厚重的博士學位論文，是一場考驗學者心智毅力與意志力的漫長馬拉松持久戰。

examples.en: Maintain an even 5-minute-per-kilometer pace to avoid hitting the wall early.
examples.zh: 全程維持穩定的每公里五分速配速節奏，能有效避免在三十公里後提早撞牆。

examples.en: The anxious father began to pace nervously back and forth outside the maternity ward.
examples.zh: 焦慮不安的準爸爸在產房走廊外神經緊繃地來回焦急踱步。

examples.en: You need to pace yourself evenly throughout the multi-stage exam so you don't run out of energy.
examples.zh: 在這場跨越數個節次的漫長考試中，你必須妥善調節答題節奏與步調，以免提早力竭。

examples.en: Runners followed the 4-hour balloon pacer to manage their race rhythm.
examples.zh: 許多全馬跑者全程緊跟著頭戴四小時氣球的專業配速員，精準掌控比賽節奏。

examples.en: Official pacers run with remarkable accuracy, crossing timing mats within seconds of schedule.
examples.zh: 官方配速員具備驚人的精準巡航能力，每次跨過感應計時地墊的秒差都在原廠計畫內。

examples.en: An elite pacer led the front pack through the first 30 kilometers at world-record speed.
examples.zh: 頂尖菁英配速兔子引領著領先集團以打破世界紀錄的凌厲速度狂飆跑完前三十公里。

examples.en: Crossing the marathon finish line after grueling training brought immense joy.
examples.zh: 歷經數月艱苦備戰後終於昂首衝過馬拉松終點線的那一刻，內心湧現無比激動與喜悅。

examples.en: Spectators cheered enthusiastically as the tired runners sprinted toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 夾道圍觀的熱情群眾大聲加油吶喊，為精疲力竭卻全力衝向終點線的跑者熱烈打氣。

examples.en: We are finally approaching the finish line of this arduous six-month engineering project.
examples.zh: 歷經長達半年日以繼夜的艱辛奮戰，我們終於迎向了這項龐大工程專案的最後完工終點線。

words.definition: 跑者愉悅感 (腦內啡多巴胺分泌)

examples.en: Endorphin release during long runs induces a blissful, energized runner's high.
examples.zh: 長距離路跑過程中大腦大量分泌腦內啡與多巴胺，帶來通體舒暢的跑者愉悅感。

examples.en: After passing the 15-kilometer mark, she felt an effortless wave of runner's high wash over her.
examples.zh: 在跑過十五公里標誌牌後，她感受到一股毫不費力、神采飛揚的跑者愉悅感油然而生。

examples.en: Many dedicated distance athletes describe the runner's high as an addictive natural euphoria.
examples.zh: 許多長跑老手將這種跑步帶來的愉悅感形容為一種令人難以抗拒且純天然的精神亢奮。

examples.en: Trail running through Yangmingshan forests combines nature exploration with fitness.
examples.zh: 穿梭於陽明山國家公園原始古道森林中的越野路跑，兼具了大自然探索與極致體能鍛鍊。

examples.en: Unlike road running, trail running demands constant agility to hop over tree roots and slippery mud.
examples.zh: 不同於路面平整的一般公路路跑，越野山徑野跑需要極佳的靈敏敏捷度以跳越樹根與泥濘。

examples.en: Equip yourself with trail running shoes featuring aggressive rubber lugs for rocky terrain grip.
examples.zh: 請穿著搭載深齒痕粗獷大底的專業越野跑鞋，以應對崎嶇碎石與濕滑山路的地表抓地力。

words.definition: 鐵人三項（游泳、自行車、路跑）

examples.en: The Taitung Ironman triathlon attracts world-class athletes to eastern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 一年一度在台東活水湖盛大登場的超級鐵人三項賽吸引了全球頂尖耐力王者齊聚一堂。

examples.en: Training for an Olympic-distance triathlon requires balancing swimming, cycling, and running sessions.
examples.zh: 為奧運標準距離鐵人三項備戰，必須精準分配時間在游泳、單車與路跑三大項目之間。

examples.en: Completing his first triathlon fulfilled a personal dream ten years in the making.
examples.zh: 終於成功跨越個人首座鐵人三項終點拱門，圓滿實現了他長達十年的夢想清單。

examples.en: Taiwan is a global paradise for road cycling, featuring the famous KOM Challenge.
examples.zh: 台灣是享譽全球的自行車騎乘天堂，其中太魯閣東進武嶺 KOM 登山王挑戰名揚國際。

examples.en: Daily cycling to work along protected riverside paths saves money and clears the mind.
examples.zh: 每天騎自行車沿著河濱專用自行車道悠閒通勤上班，既能節省開銷又能沉澱思緒。

examples.en: Wearing a safety helmet is an essential cycling precaution for both urban and mountain riding.
examples.zh: 配戴安全安全帽是無論在市區穿梭或挑戰陡峭山路時皆不可或缺的單車騎乘防護守則。

examples.en: Hiking Taiwan's legendary 'Baiyue' (Top 100 Peaks) rewards climbers with cloud seas.
examples.zh: 挑戰攀登台灣百岳高山健行，沿途壯麗壯闊的翻騰雲海日出能洗滌所有登山者的疲憊。

examples.en: Bring trekking poles, rain jackets, and headlamps whenever you go hiking in remote backcountry.
examples.zh: 無論何時深入偏遠山林進行登山健行，請務必隨身攜帶登山杖、專業雨衣與頭燈備用。

examples.en: Weekend hiking on suburban trails allows busy office workers to reconnect with pristine nature.
examples.zh: 週末走入近郊登山步道健行，能讓終日忙碌的上班族徹底放鬆身心並回歸大自然的懷抱。

words.definition: 抱石攀岩（無繩索低高度）

examples.en: Indoor bouldering gyms offer color-coded problem routes for beginner climbers.
examples.zh: 室內抱石攀岩館為新手與進階岩友規劃了以不同顏色岩塊標註等級的抱石路線。

examples.en: Bouldering is a climbing discipline performed on short walls over thick safety crash pads.
examples.zh: 抱石攀岩是一種在離地數公尺矮牆上進行、底下鋪滿厚實安全防墜軟墊的無繩攀岩運動。

examples.en: Solving complex bouldering routes requires creative problem-solving, finger grip, and core tension.
examples.zh: 成功解開高難度抱石路線需要發揮靈活的解題思維、強大的指力與全身核心張力。

examples.en: Green Island and Kenting are renowned destinations for vibrant coral scuba diving.
examples.zh: 綠島與墾丁是名揚四海的水肺潛水勝地，海底坐落著五彩斑斕的熱帶魚群與珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Divers must complete certified training before they can rent gear and go scuba diving.
examples.zh: 潛水同好必須先考取國際認證的開放水域潛水員證照，方能租賃裝備展開水肺潛水。

examples.en: We hovered weightlessly above a colorful reef during an unforgettable scuba diving session.
examples.zh: 在一趟令人難忘的水肺潛水旅程中，我們宛如太空漫步般輕盈無重力地懸浮在七彩珊瑚礁上方。

examples.en: Tourists loved snorkeling with wild green sea turtles in crystal-clear Xiaoliuqiu waters.
examples.zh: 遊客在小琉球清澈見底的湛藍海水中與悠游的野生綠蠵龜一同浮潛同樂。

examples.en: Even young children can enjoy snorkeling with a mask, breathing tube, and life vest.
examples.zh: 即便是年幼的孩童，只要戴上面鏡、呼吸管並穿妥救生衣，也能輕鬆享受浮潛的樂趣。

examples.en: The calm, shallow bay provided a safe environment for first-time visitors to try snorkeling.
examples.zh: 這處風平浪靜、水質清澈的淺灣為初次體驗浮潛的遊客提供了一個絕佳安全的環境。

examples.en: Yilan's Waiao Beach offers perfect breaking ocean waves for weekend surfing.
examples.zh: 宜蘭頭城外澳海灘擁有得天獨厚的綿延浪況，是北部衝浪客週末逐浪的衝浪勝地。

examples.en: Learning to pop up smoothly on a surfboard takes balance, practice, and paddling power.
examples.zh: 學會敏捷流暢地在衝浪板上迅速起乘站立，需要良好的平衡感、反覆練習與划水臂力。

examples.en: Surf camps in Taitung teach ocean wave safety and paddling fundamentals to beginners.
examples.zh: 台東東河的專業衝浪學校為初學者深入傳授辨識海浪安全知識與基礎划水起乘基本功。

examples.en: Practicing martial arts like Judo and Taekwondo develops discipline and self-defense.
examples.zh: 修練柔道與跆拳道等傳統武術格鬥技藝能培養嚴謹自律品格並具備防身自衛能力。

examples.en: The legendary martial arts master demonstrated fluid sword forms to his disciples.
examples.zh: 這位享譽武林的傳奇武術宗師向門下親傳弟子示範行雲流水、氣吞山河的太極劍法。

examples.en: Mixed martial arts (MMA) blends boxing, Muay Thai, wrestling, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.
examples.zh: 綜合格鬥技（MMA）博採眾長，融合了西洋拳擊、泰拳、自由式角力與巴西柔術。

words.definition: 體操競技；鞍馬跳馬體操

examples.en: The Taiwanese pommel horse specialist won Olympic silver with flawless routines.
examples.zh: 台灣鞍馬王子在奧運競技體操舞台上以行雲流水、零瑕疵的完美落地榮獲銀牌。

examples.en: Gymnastics builds incredible full-body strength, spatial awareness, and muscular control.
examples.zh: 體操訓練能培養令人驚嘆的全身協調力量、敏銳空間感知力與極致的肌肉精準控制度。

examples.en: Young children in tumbling gymnastics develop extraordinary balance and flexibility.
examples.zh: 自幼參與滾翻體操啟蒙班的小朋友能培養出超凡的身體平衡感與肢體柔軟度。

words.definition: 復健治療；運動醫學康復 (Rehab)

examples.en: Professional sports rehabilitation restored the pitcher's shoulder mobility safely.
examples.zh: 專業的運動復健物理治療幫助王牌投手安全修復肩關節旋轉肌群並重返巔峰身手。

examples.en: Following surgery on his torn ligament, the striker spent six months in intensive rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 在經歷了韌帶撕裂修補手術後，這位明星前鋒投入了長達半年的密集物理復健治療。

examples.en: Modern rehabilitation programs emphasize active resistance movements over passive bed rest.
examples.zh: 當代前瞻運動醫學復健觀念強調透過主動式負重阻力運動，來取代消極被動的臥床靜養。

examples.en: Proper sleep hygiene and mental coaching elevate peak athletic performance.
examples.zh: 養成良好的深度睡眠規律搭配運動心理諮商輔導，能顯著拉升選手在賽場上的巔峰表現。

examples.en: The crowd applauded enthusiastically following the symphony orchestra's breathtaking performance.
examples.zh: 在交響樂團帶來令人屏息震撼的精彩協奏曲演出後，全場聽眾爆發出熱烈持久的掌聲。

examples.en: High-altitude acclimatization training optimizes an endurance athlete's marathon performance.
examples.zh: 進行高原低氧適應耐受訓練能極致優化耐力運動員在全馬賽事中的綜合體能表現。
